primaryTextRead.text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list lines 3145–3149, Heresh subsection: along with Galal, Mattaniah and Bakbakkar described as Levite and descendant of Asaph, citing 1 Chr 9:15.
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、歴代誌上9:15でヘレシュ、ガラル、マタヌヤ、バクバカルをアサフの子孫のレビ人としてまとめます。節の父祖関係は、本文で明示される範囲を超えてガラル個人に割り当てません。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The source groups Galal with the named Levites and descendants of Asaph at 1 Chr 9:15; WEB’s exact genealogy apposition remains limited.
